description: This file implements a JSON-RPC response parser for AWS SDK, specifically handling the parsing logic for responses conforming to JSON-RPC protocol, such as DynamoDB. It defines a class 'JsonRpcParser' that extends 'AbstractParser' and uses traits and external classes to process API responses.

classes.name: JsonRpcParser
classes.description: A parser class for handling JSON-RPC responses within AWS SDK, particularly for services like DynamoDB that use JSON-RPC protocol.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with a given Service description and an optional JsonParser instance.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the parser on a given command and response, returning a Result object.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses the response based on the JSON RPC protocol, handling event stream members and normal members.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Parses a message member from a stream using the provided parser.
